sections.subtitle: Practical, instructor-led AI training at our Dublin and Cork offices, at your premises nationwide, and live online. Help your team save time, streamline workflows and apply AI to everyday business challenges.

sections.title: About our AI courses
content: Generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot can draft documents, summarise reports and meetings, analyse data and answer questions in plain language. Used well, they save time on everyday tasks and help teams produce better work in almost every role.

Our instructor-led courses give you the practical skills to use these tools confidently and responsibly. You will learn how to write clear requests, check AI output for accuracy, protect sensitive information and build AI into your daily work. For managers, we also cover where AI adds real value, how to assess the risks and how to plan a successful rollout. No technical background is needed.

quotes.text: I got a great insight on how to approach AI and structure prompts to get the most helpful response.  The trainer was so practical and hands-on with examples.   The scope to use the tools to interact and optimise repetitive tasks gave me a realistic expectation of what AI can be used for.  Learning about Power Query and using AI to show how to pull data from PDF documents to Excel was great!
quotes.name: AI in the Workplace course participant

quotes.text: The AI-Assisted Data Automation training was a Gold Standard.  Taking the skills from our group sessions and applying them to our day-to-day roles has saved hours in reporting time weekly.  Learning how to work with AI to create repeatable skills is freeing my team for more time on data analysis and generating real, practical insights and process improvements.
